summary: Iteration 10 full-stack test: offered_subjects lookup scoping, class detail endpoint/page, leadership assignment (teacher/leader/2nd), achievements CRUD + validation + cascade, and Class Hub regressions. Backend pytest: 11/13 passed (2 failures both from ONE real bug: invalid ids are persisted to Mongo before validation rejects the PUT with 400). All frontend flows passed end to end.

critical.issue: Mongo $set is applied BEFORE enrich_institution_doc validation runs, so a rejected payload is still persisted. Repro: PUT {class_teacher_id:'bogus-id'} -> 400 'Selected teacher not found', but GET /api/res/classes/{id} then shows class_teacher_id='bogus-id' (stale class_teacher name kept). Side effects: the class detail page dropdown shows blank/stale selection, Leader/2nd badges break (class_leader_id no longer matches any student), and EVERY subsequent leadership save on that class fails with 'Selected teacher not found' until the user re-picks a valid teacher — i.e. the record becomes un-updatable. Same pattern applies to class_leader_id/second_leader_id and to any resource validated in enrich_institution_doc (enrollments, teacher_assignments). Fix: validate/enrich the merged doc first, then write once (single $set), or wrap in a read-validate-write.

action_items: Fix update_resource to validate before persisting (currently invalid class_teacher_id/class_leader_id/second_leader_id are written to Mongo even though the API returns 400).
critical_code_review_comments: update_resource(): db.update_one runs before enrich_institution_doc validation -> non-atomic, corrupting write on 400. Should merge existing+updates, validate, then single $set.
server.py is 1479 lines - consider splitting resources/lookups/detail endpoints into modules (guideline: >700 lines).

Only open bug = non-atomic PUT (see backend_issues). Run test_iteration10.py after the fix; the 2 failing tests assert non-persistence and self-restore the seed leadership.
rca_of_the_issue: In /app/backend/server.py update_resource (line ~417) the code executes `await db[resource].update_one(query, {"$set": updates})` and only afterwards calls enrich_institution_doc, which raises HTTPException(400) for unknown teacher/student ids. The 400 therefore happens post-write, leaving invalid foreign-key ids stored. Because the next PUT re-validates the whole merged doc (which now contains the bad id), the class is locked out of further leadership updates.
